final: WITH operator_metrics AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) as total_scans, AVG(gbsize/spanmin) as avg_gb_per_min FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND scancount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY crewref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(gbsize/spanmin) as overall_avg FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL), filtered_ops AS (SELECT om.total_scans, om.avg_gb_per_min, (om.avg_gb_per_min - oa.overall_avg) as margin_above FROM operator_metrics om CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE om.avg_gb_per_min > oa.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(total_scans) as avg_total_scans, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min, AVG(margin_above) as avg_margin_above_overall FROM filtered_ops
